name: Bock saga
overview: When Ior Bock begins recounting the Bock saga to his followers in Goa in 1984, a movement of seekers, disciples and temple hunters emerges. The search for the Temple of Lemminkäinen in Sipoo is merely the prelude to a colorful mythology of rituals, devotion and grand promises. However, beneath the surface lie conflicts, lies and violence. Decades later, the Bock saga is revived in the rabbit holes of internet conspiracy theorists, and the old mysteries clash with new dark forces.
